verdict.rationale: Synctera docs confirm a Cards API that issues, activates, and manages cards for customers as part of the same platform/API as accounts, and marketing copy mentions card personalization and 'financial wellness' features, implying some spend-control capability. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms virtual vs. physical card issuance, granular spend controls, or digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning. missing for 10: explicit virtual/physical card distinction, documented spend-control parameters, digital wallet tokenization/push-provisioning support.
